svg.text: Residential towers — cores, columns, balcony cantilevers, declared transfer

black = floorplate at the base (dashed = at the top, turned) · red = column ring at the base, pink = at the top, with each column’s inclined travel · blue = balcony edges (every 3rd floor) · orange = upper-penthouse transfer line
north ↑ · 1 m = 9 px · conceptual, not to be used for construction
